title: Follow up with every new lead, qualify it and offer a booking link
systemName: Your lead follow-up and booking system

facts: Post text from the Vollna RSS copy pulled 2026-10-26 12:28 CT; the Upwork job page returned PERMISSION twice, so screening questions and client details are unknown.

Post: leads come from the website and sometimes Facebook, follow-up is slow. Wants: check the details, ask a few basic qualifying questions if needed, save everything in the CRM, tell the team if the lead is worth calling, offer a qualified lead a booking link or schedule a call.

Post: already uses a CRM (not named), open to n8n, Make or another tool, wants something simple and reliable. Asks what we built, tools used and how long it took. A short demo or screen recording is welcome.

CRM is unnamed, so the CRM step is an n8n HTTP Request to their CRM's API and the record view is the custom workspace, never a vendor screen. The team alert uses the n8n Slack node as the sample channel; the real channel is agreed with the client.

scenes.title: A new lead comes in and gets sorted right away.
scenes.caption: The form starts the workflow, AI checks the answers, and the lead is saved to your CRM before anyone touches it.
scenes.beat: When {{lead.name}} fills in the website form, this n8n workflow starts. It cleans up the details, has AI check the answers against your qualifying questions, and saves the lead to your CRM. Because {{lead.first}} is worth a call, your team gets an alert and {{lead.first}} gets a booking link. If a lead is missing answers, it goes down the other branch and gets a short email with a few questions instead.
